description: You’re ready for more than the next ticket You’ve got a few years of engineering experience behind you and you’re already good at what you do. You’re now looking for more in a role than being handed a ticket, expected to ship it and move on. You want to work alongside people who will make you better. You want to tackle meaningful technical problems and have room to try things. You want to be in a place that takes AI seriously without treating it as a shortcut for good thinking. That’s what this role is about. The work you’ll get stuck into At Envato , we help creative professionals bring their ideas to life through world-class creative assets and AI tools. Behind the scenes, our Content Management team builds the systems that make all of that possible. Content upload, processing, metadata, storage, distribution and the human and AI-assisted review that keeps our marketplace moving. It is complex, high-impact work and you’ll be right in the middle of it. You’ll take ownership of features and well defined projects from the first conversation through to production. You’ll build software that is reliable, well-tested and designed to last, while getting to know the platform and the people who use it. When something breaks, you’ll help understand why, fix it properly and leave the system better than you found it. A place to build your craft You’ll work closely with Lead and Senior Engineers through regular pairing, feedback and problem solving. This is a team that cares about strong engineering craft, but isn’t precious about how things have always been done. If you have a better idea, we want to hear it. We work AI-first. We use agents to write, test and review code, but we’re still working out the best ways to use them. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, challenge old ways of working and bring ideas that move us forward. You’ll be a great fit if… You have experience building software, strong back-end capability and a real interest in doing the work well. Ruby on Rails would be useful, though experience in a comparable framework matters just as much. You know the value of clean code, sensible trade-offs and testing, and you’re comfortable getting curious when a production issue needs solving. You’re interested in using AI in practical ways, but you bring your own judgement rather than blindly accepting the output. Experience with AWS, Terraform, Docker, Buildkite, Datadog, Rollbar, or content-heavy systems is helpful, but what matters most is your appetite to learn quickly, take ownership and bring more than the expected answer. Life at Envato We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow. Our benefits include home office, team connection & learning budgets, wellbeing and study support, volunteer leave, generous paid parental leave, access to all our products, and the option to apply to work from another remote location for up to 3 months per year. We embrace diversity at Envato and want to ensure that everyone who applies for a role with us has an inclusive experience. Hiring for us isn't a tick box exercise, we want to know what you're passionate about, what our lived experiences are and what you think you can add to the team. We're also big believers in using AI, and that includes how we hire. We may use AI tools to help support our recruitment process, but they don't replace human judgement. Our people always make the final hiring decisions. By submitting your application, you agree to our Privacy Policy . We encourage you to read it before applying to understand how we collect, use and handle your personal information. We appreciate the time you’ve taken to apply to Envato and we're committed to responding to every applicant. You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024. #LI-Remote Compensation Additional Information

ABOUT THE ROLE The Junior Quality Specialist supports the quality assurance process to ensure websites are accurate, functional, visually consistent, and aligned with Luxury Presence standards. You review websites using established QA guidelines and checklists, identifying and documenting issues before they reach the client. This is an entry-level role focused on developing strong attention to detail, design judgment, and technical QA skills while learning from experienced team members. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR Quality Assurance Website QA: Review websites for content accuracy, functionality, design consistency, responsiveness, and completeness using established QA checklists. Quality Standards: Follow QA processes to identify, document, and report issues clearly for efficient resolution. Issue Identification: Flag missing content, formatting inconsistencies, broken links, visual issues, and potential compliance concerns, escalating complex findings when needed. Client Vision & Brand Representation Brand Alignment: Verify that websites follow the client's provided branding, design framework, and requirements. Visual Consistency: Identify inconsistencies in imagery, spacing, typography, colors, and overall website presentation. Team Collaboration & Feedback Quality Feedback: Provide clear, specific, and actionable feedback to Website Builders and Data Specialists. Collaboration: Work with senior Quality Specialists and production teams to clarify issues and support timely corrections. Product & Process Improvement Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring issues and share observations that could help improve quality and workflows. Problem Solving: Research basic QA and design issues using available resources, SOPs, and internal tools, escalating complex challenges when appropriate. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Experience 0–1 years of experience in website QA, quality control, web design, or a related field. Basic understanding of website functionality, responsive design, and UX/UI principles is a plus. Familiarity with website editors, QA tools, or design platforms is a plus, but not required. Willingness to learn Luxury Presence quality standards, design best practices, and compliance guidelines. Skills & Mindset Attention to Detail: Strong ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and missing information. Visual Awareness: Good eye for design with an interest in developing stronger judgment around layout, spacing, typography, imagery, and overall website quality. Clear Communication: Ability to provide organized, respectful, and actionable written feedback. Critical Thinking: Willingness to investigate issues, ask questions, and understand the reasoning behind quality standards. Process-Oriented: Comfortable following established QA guidelines, checklists, and SOPs. AI Fluency: Comfortable learning and using AI tools to support QA reviews, research, and efficiency. Growth Mindset: Receptive to feedback, eager to learn, and motivated to continuously improve. Reliability: Organized, dependable, and able to manage assigned reviews within established timelines. Core Values Professionalism – Show up prepared, respectful, and dependable. Ownership – Take responsibility for assigned work and follow through. Communication – Ask questions, communicate blockers, and provide timely updates. Collaboration – Work well with others, seek guidance, and contribute to team success. Excellence – Strive to deliver accurate, consistent, and high-quality work. Adaptability – Be open to feedback, new tools, and evolving processes. Integrity – Do the right thing, even when no one is watching. OTHER REQUIREMENTS Must be a current resident of the Philippines Willing to work graveyard hours, 5 days a week, 9 hours a day (with a one-hour meal break) Own a laptop or desktop Have a valid government ID Have an existing bank account or willing to open one if hired Have a stable internet connection that is at least 100 mbps and have a back-up connection too Live in area where there is stable power supply that is not interrupted by constant power outages Compensation Additional Information

Who are we? At UpGuard , we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk. We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface. We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale. Our Product team at UpGuard comprises our Product Management, Product Support, Engineering, Design, Data Leaks Detection, and Third Party Risk Management Services. Our Product team’s vision is to become the leader in the Cyber VRM category by providing a best-in-class SaaS platform for organisations to manage their third-party risk and external attack surface. Our purpose as a Product team is simply to build a product that enables this. We aim to build a product that users love and come to rely on, and one that regularly and consistently improves. About The Role We’re hiring engineers at multiple levels to join our Product Engineering team as we continue to scale rapidly and sustain strong growth. As Software Engineers at UpGuard, we immerse ourselves in the swiftly evolving and increasingly vital realm of cybersecurity. Our focus is on presenting data in intelligent and creative ways, crafting integrated solutions that directly influence the security posture of our global customers. With the majority of the internet scanned across multiple vectors daily, we confront challenges like high throughput, massive concurrency, and big data. The way we address these challenges reflects the essence of the engineers we welcome into our team. In this role, you’ll work within a cross-functional team that values iteration, collaboration, and speed. Together, we deliver customer value quickly while ensuring security and reliability at every step. We value clean code, thoughtful design, and engineers who care about the product as much as the technology it is built on. What you’ll do: Collaborate with a cross-functional team of engineers, product managers, and designers to create world-class products. Own and develop new customer-facing features end-to-end Improve system reliability, scalability, and performance Contribute to code reviews, technical discussions and architectural decisions. Explore an interesting, challenging domain, mastering the fundamentals of cybersecurity and the internet. What you'll bring: 4+ years of relevant engineering experience at tech-centric and product-driven companies Curious about exploring new technologies, particularly AI and LLMs, to enhance both developer productivity and customer experience Experience with JavaScript, React, and other web technologies Proficiency with a backend language (we use Go) Proficiency with relational databases (we use Postgres) Excited to help shape product features that improve user experience and drive impact Able to make pragmatic trade-offs in design and delivery, balancing technical quality with business needs What will give you an edge: Experience in cybersecurity. If not, you’ll just need to be willing to learn Comfortable building complex applications and systems from the ground up in collaboration with cross-functional teams Care deeply about user experience and are motivated by building products that make a meaningful impact for customers Have a humble attitude and a strong desire to contribute to the team’s success We use a modern stack, including React, Go, and Kubernetes, on Google Cloud Platform, so experience with these technologies is a plus. Why you’ll love it here: A strong engineering culture focused on learning, impact, and craftsmanship Opportunities to work on cutting-edge problems in security, AI, and scale. Regular team off-sites, collaborative professional development, and a no-ego culture. What's in it for you: Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: Use this for financial, physical, and mental well-being WFH set-up allowance: To ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set up within your first 3 months at UpGuard $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: To support your career development, all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries. 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: Irrespective of parenting role Personal Leave Allowance: This includes sick & carer’s leave Fully remote working environment: While we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance Top-spec hardware: All team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work #LI-SR1 UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work, apply now to find out why! About Halter At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures . To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram . About the role Halter's component suppliers are predominantly based across Asia. The components they produce have to be right before they ever reach our contract manufacturers. When something is wrong, we need someone on the ground who can get to the root cause fast, push through to a real fix, and prevent it from happening again. The Supplier Quality Principal is Halter's senior technical authority embedded in Asia. You'll lead highly technical supplier audits, own complex quality problem-solving at our suppliers, and work directly with both suppliers and Halter's design teams to ensure that what comes off a supplier's production line meets the standard we set. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy, covering a portfolio of suppliers across the region and acting as the technical bridge between our Asia supply base and the Halter team in Auckland. This is not a compliance role. Ticking audit checkboxes and filing reports is not what this job is about. The best person for this role is someone who goes deep: who can walk a production line and immediately identify what's controlling quality and what isn't, who can sit with a supplier's engineers and work through a failure mode from first principles, and who knows the difference between a corrective action that actually solves a problem and one that just looks good on paper. You'll report to the Head of Supplier Quality and work closely with Halter's hardware design and operations teams. When there's a quality issue in Asia that needs solving, you're the person we call. You'll be measured on the technical quality of audits, the speed and effectiveness of issue resolution at suppliers, and your ability to build supplier capability over time. What You'll Do Technical Supplier Auditing Lead technically rigorous audits of Halter's component suppliers across Asia, going well beyond system compliance to assess process control, measurement capability, and the reliability of how suppliers actually build and inspect parts. Identify the real drivers of quality performance at a supplier, not just the documented procedures, and develop clear, prioritised findings that distinguish between critical risks and cosmetic gaps. Conduct pre-qualification audits of new suppliers, assessing their technical capability and readiness to meet Halter's design and quality requirements before commitments are made. Run periodic surveillance audits to verify that corrective actions have been implemented effectively and that quality performance is being sustained. Develop and continuously improve Halter's audit methodology and supplier assessment criteria, ensuring audits capture what actually matters for component quality. Technical Problem Solving Own the resolution of complex quality issues at suppliers, using first-principles analysis to identify root cause and drive effective corrective actions rather than superficial fixes. When a production failure or OQC rejection occurs, lead rapid on-site analysis with supplier engineers and Halter's design team to understand the failure mode, assess risk to in-flight inventory, and define the fastest path to resolution. Work with suppliers to improve their process controls, measurement systems, and inspection methods so that quality issues are caught and corrected at source, not downstream. Coach supplier engineering teams to develop their own capability for root cause analysis and corrective action, building their ability to self-solve rather than depend on Halter for every issue. Escalate issues clearly and early when resolution is taking too long, a supplier is not engaging in good faith, or a quality risk to production is emerging. Quality Assurance Specifications Implement and maintain Halter's quality assurance specifications at suppliers, ensuring specifications are understood, accepted, and consistently applied across the production process. Work with Halter's hardware design team and the Head of Supplier Quality to refine QA specifications where field experience, audit findings, or supplier feedback reveals gaps or ambiguity. Ensure that when designs evolve, updated specifications are communicated to suppliers, implemented correctly, and re-validated before affected parts re-enter supply. Challenge specifications that are unclear, unmeasurable, or misaligned with what suppliers can realistically control, bringing engineering and operations teams to a better standard. Part Approval and Ongoing Compliance Support supplier-side part approval activities, ensuring new and revised components are formally validated against Halter's specifications before production release. Maintain a clear picture of approval status and open quality issues across the suppliers in your portfolio, tracking corrective actions to closure and flagging risks to supply continuity. Collaborate with the Head of Contract Manufacturing Quality when parts that pass supplier OQC fail IQC at our contract manufacturers, working to determine whether root cause sits with the supplier process, the OQC criteria, or the incoming inspection. Supplier Development Build genuine working relationships with quality and engineering counterparts at key suppliers, creating the trust and technical credibility that allows hard conversations to happen fast. Identify where suppliers have systemic capability gaps and develop structured improvement plans that address root cause, not symptoms. Share Halter's standards, expectations, and technical knowledge with suppliers in a way that builds their capability over time rather than creating dependency. What You Bring 15 or more years of experience in supplier quality or manufacturing quality for complex electromechanical hardware, with a proven track record of solving technically difficult quality problems at suppliers. Deep manufacturing and process engineering knowledge. You understand how parts are made, what drives process variation, and how to identify whether a supplier's process is actually in control. Exceptional audit capability. You conduct audits that go beneath the surface, uncover the real quality risks, and produce findings that drive meaningful improvement. Strong first-principles thinking. When you see a quality failure, you work back to the actual root cause, not the nearest plausible explanation. Experience with QA specification development and the ability to assess whether a specification is clear, measurable, and correctly implemented at a supplier. High proficiency in both English and Mandarin (written, verbal, and reading). You can work directly with Chinese engineers and leadership without translation. Comfortable operating autonomously across a portfolio of suppliers. You manage your own priorities, escalate the right things at the right time, and don't need close supervision to stay effective. Firm, fair, and direct with suppliers. You hold a high standard, push back on inadequate corrective actions, and maintain a relationship that is professional and productive even when conversations are hard. Willing to travel regularly across APAC. A significant portion of your time will be on-site at suppliers. A Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline is preferred. About the role Halter is searching for a Lead Supply Quality Engineer to take responsibility for ensuring that every component in our supply chain is delivered at quality and on time. If you are an expert in implementing and managing quality systems to catch issues early, resolve them quickly, and ensure high-quality components are always delivered on-time at our Contract Manufacturers, we want to talk to you! Our Hardware manufacturing is accelerating quickly to satisfy our growing global markets and it is vital that every component that is shipped to our contract manufacturers in Asia is ready for the tough environment it will face on farm, once it is assembled into Halter hardware. What your day could look like Implement statistical process control methods for the manufacturing process of critical parts and work with the suppliers to ensure this is reflected in their process control plan After a failure during production or OQC inspection at a supplier, run a rapid sprint analysis with design engineers to unblock the release of the shipment with risk-mitigative actions and keep production running with effective preventive measures Update and implement quality control documentation to protect against future failures, based on root cause analysis that identified a component issue after, first flagged when a collar went offline on a farm in Australia Audit the compliance with Halter’s quality requirements at a new supplier and work with the supplier to quickly close any non-conformances you found What we are looking for: 5+ years of experience in quality management for high-volume manufacturing. Production of electromechanical products is preferred Committed to personal development and staying current with relevant industry standards, methods, and trends. Proven experience in responding to and resolving quality issues rapidly to minimise production disruption Demonstrated first principles thinking and ability to hone in on the most important issues during audit or reviewing problems Experience in working with suppliers to achieve required outcomes based on context High proficiency (written, verbal and reading) in English and Mandarin (preferred) Relevant quality-related qualifications such as ASQ certification (for example CQE or CQA) are beneficial, as is formal Internal Auditor Certification Willing to travel regularly around APAC (25%+ of your time) Someone who will thrive in a close team environment and can work well in the self-directed and demanding environment of a rapidly scaling company A commitment to personal development and staying current with relevant industry standards, methods, and trends. Company Overview LevelUp is a specialist agency providing outsourcing solutions to agencies, software vendors, and website owners. For over seven years, we have successfully collaborated with a variety of companies, providing valuable technical, operational, and back-office support. We have a large team of skilled and passionate professionals who are committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients. Position Overview We are seeking a Software Developer (often referred to as a Next.js Developer) with considerable years of commercial production experience to join our team. In this role, you will not just be working through a rigid ticket queue—you will have real end-to-end ownership of systems, make critical technical decisions, and see them through. You will collaborate directly with our Head of Operations, our Product Lead, and our Founder/CEO to translate delivery requirements and rough designs into beautiful, functional, and secure web applications. This is a full-time, remote position based in the Philippines, working with our team in Brisbane, Australia. Your working hours will align with the Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) shift (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM), allowing for close daily collaboration while enjoying the flexibility that an asynchronous-first working style provides. Reference: 2638-244499 Responsibilities Application Development: Design, build, and ship robust, high-quality web applications using Next.js and modern JavaScript, ensuring clean CSS structures and a strong focus on responsive layouts. Component Translation: Take rough designs, wireframes, and delivery requirements and shape them into highly usable, well-structured, and maintainable components and interfaces. Integrations & Data Tooling: Build and maintain secure integrations between major HR/payroll platforms, client databases, and our own internal tooling. Cloud Operations (Azure): Deploy, manage, and run applications in our Microsoft Azure environment, leveraging app services, storage accounts, Entra ID (identity), and CI/CD deployment pipelines. Quality Assurance: Write and maintain automated tests, and actively participate in code reviews both as an author and a constructive reviewer. Production Support & Debugging: Monitor production systems, investigate issues proactively, and implement permanent fixes targeting root causes rather than temporary symptoms. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with consultants, project managers, and internal stakeholders to contribute to technical decisions, provide estimates, and thoroughly document what you build. Security & Compliance: Handle sensitive employee and payroll information with the highest degree of judgment, discretion, and compliance with data privacy best practices. Requirements Next.js & React Expert: 3 to 5 years of demonstrated commercial experience building and shipping production-grade applications. You must have deep practical knowledge of routing, data fetching, rendering strategies (SSR, SSG, ISR), and the React ecosystem. Modern JavaScript & TypeScript: Strong proficiency in modern ES JavaScript, asynchronous programming patterns, and API utilization. TypeScript is highly regarded and expected for writing clean, type-safe code. Frontend & CSS Craft: A strong eye for interface detail, responsive design, and accessibility (a11y) basics. You can write CSS that is built to be maintained and can take a raw wireframe and make it feel like a polished, complete interface. API & Systems Integration: Solid experience building and maintaining integrations (REST, GraphQL, Webhooks) between third-party platforms and internal tools. Automated Testing & Code Quality: Proven experience writing automated unit/integration tests and taking an active, non-ego-driven role in code reviews. Security Conscious: Safe, production-proven habits regarding managing environment variables, encryption, secrets, and handling highly sensitive employee and payroll data. Superb Written Communication: Exceptional written English is a hard requirement. You must be able to document your work thoroughly and explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical colleagues in plain, clear language. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent commercial experience. Desirable - Azure Infrastructure: Hands-on experience deploying and operating on Microsoft Azure (App Services, Storage Accounts, Entra ID, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions CI/CD). Desirable - Atlassian Tooling: Comfort using Jira and Confluence for task management, sprint planning, estimation, and central documentation. Desirable - Python: Basic to intermediate skills for integrations, data transformations, and migration tooling. Desirable - HR / Payroll Domain Exposure: Any experience integrating with human resources information systems (HRIS), applicant tracking systems (ATS), or payroll systems is a massive plus. More Information This is a fully remote position with a standard 40-hour fixed-schedule work week. We have a company culture that focuses on the well-being of its team members, with a good work life balance and respectful work environment. Benefits: Basic Philippines government-mandated benefits (13th-month pay, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG), remote setup support, and holiday observance of Philippine holidays. Equipment provided Compensation Additional Information

Position Overview Join LevelUp and partner with a premier UK-based HubSpot Diamond Partner dedicated to accelerating the growth of technology companies. They are pioneering AI-first HubSpot architectures—intelligent CRMs that autonomously update from sales calls, propel deals forward, and prescribe the next best actions for sales teams. In this critical role, you will lead client discovery sessions, architect tailored HubSpot solutions, and independently build the most complex system components. You will champion each project from its initial workshop through testing, training, and final launch. This is neither a basic configuration job nor a people management role. We seek a technical expert with a comprehensive understanding of HubSpot's current capabilities, who excels at translating complex technical strategies to non-technical stakeholders and thrives on end-to-end project ownership. This is a permanent, fully remote position operating on a UK night shift schedule from the Philippines. Schedule & Work Setup • Shift: Permanent night shift aligned with UK business hours: 5:00 PM to 1:00 AM (Manila time) from late October to late March, and 4:00 PM to 12:00 AM from late March to late October. • Location: Fully remote. • Equipment: LevelUp provides the necessary hardware, including a laptop, monitor, and headset. • Requirements: You must have a dedicated, quiet workspace and a reliable backup internet connection. Reference: 2644-327166 Responsibilities Lead comprehensive discovery workshops with clients, translating business requirements into actionable HubSpot solution designs for the build team. Independently engineer technically complex components, including custom-coded actions, programmable automation, custom objects, sophisticated integrations, and HubSpot's AI features. Spearhead data migrations from legacy platforms and conduct rigorous code and build reviews for junior colleagues. Take full ownership of system testing, client sign-off, and successful go-live phases, followed by delivering effective training and driving high user adoption rates. Serve as the primary technical liaison for clients, adeptly managing expectations and navigating challenging conversations regarding scope and timeline adjustments. Collaborate on pre-sales activities by scoping and estimating work, and maintain strict change control protocols on active builds. Leverage advanced AI tools to accelerate and optimize the creation of specifications, code, testing protocols, and documentation. Requirements HubSpot Experience: 4 to 6 years of hands-on HubSpot implementation experience, preferably within a HubSpot Solutions Partner agency or technical consultancy. Up-to-Date HubSpot Knowledge: Advanced expertise in the HubSpot ecosystem, specifically in deploying modern AI features (e.g., Breeze agents, AI workflow actions) within client builds. Solution Design: Proven end-to-end solution design experience—leading discovery, architecting the solution, and managing testing and launch, rather than just executing predefined configurations. Hub Coverage: Extensive mastery of at least three HubSpot Hubs, with deep technical proficiency in Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, and Data Hub (formerly Operations Hub). Complex Builds: Demonstrated ability to execute complex builds involving custom-coded actions, programmable automation, custom objects, calculated properties, and multi-pipeline architectures. Connecting Systems: Strong integration skills using APIs, webhooks, and middleware (e.g., Zapier, Make, Workato) to connect HubSpot with external platforms like email, Slack, and Clay. Client-Facing Work: Exceptional client-facing communication skills, with a track record of leading technical workshops and articulating complex decisions to non-technical audiences. Documentation: Excellence in technical documentation, consistently producing precise solution designs, specifications, and handover notes. Nice-to-haves Possession of (or currently working towards) the HubSpot Solutions Architecture Design accreditation. Experience with CMS development, including HubDB, custom modules, and dynamic content integration. Track record of successfully managing complex data migrations from enterprise CRM or marketing platforms. Prior experience in scoping technical requirements and writing commercial proposals. A background in mentoring and upskilling junior HubSpot practitioners. More Information This is a fully remote position with a standard 40-hour fixed-schedule work week. We have a company culture that focuses on the well-being of its team members, with a good work life balance and respectful work environment. Benefits: Basic Philippines government-mandated benefits (13th-month pay, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG), remote setup support, and holiday observance of Philippine holidays. Equipment provided Compensation Additional Information

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. We're looking for an engineer to help build the future of distributed Postgres. You'll work on Multigres, our open-source distributed database system that brings horizontal scaling to Postgres. In this role, you'll architect and implement critical distributed database infrastructure including sharding, consensus protocols, and materialization systems. You'll collaborate closely with our Postgres, networking, and infrastructure teams to push the boundaries of what's possible with distributed databases. What You’ll Be Responsible for: Design and implement query routing logic for sharded databases Build consensus and replication systems to support distribute durability Develop materialization pipelines for migrations and change data capture Contribute to connection pooling infrastructure and intelligent workload isolation Collaborate with the open-source community on Multigres development You Might Be a Good Fit If You have: This role requires deep technical expertise in distributed databases and systems. For detailed qualifications, see our contributor qualifications document . Key areas of expertise: Database sharding, relational algebra, and Postgres internals Consensus protocols (Raft, Paxos, FlexPaxos) and distributed transactions Stream processing, materialization, and change data capture Building robust, performant distributed systems with strong observability Low-latency infrastructure and network protocol optimization. What We Offer Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. About the Team Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. ~400 team members 60+ countries 20+ languages spoken Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
